CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. AL POLICE
S. S. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D 79
Date March 30, 1939

Subject Enquiries regarding Mrs. L. Bennett.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Clausen

Discreet enquiries show that no person named
Mrs.L. BENNETT resides at House 15, Passage 129 Avenue
Haig. Room No. 2 in this house is occupied by Mrs.L.F.
BOGOMOLOFF, 56, Russian, and her daughter, Miss Ekaterina
Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF, 24, a ballet dancer by occupation
known under the stage name MELTSER who, it is reported, is
engaged to be married to a certain Russian.

In December, 1937 when registering with the Rus-
sian Emigrants' Committee, Moulmein Road, Miss BOGOMOLOFF-
MELTSER, who at that time resided at 132 Route Vallon, men-
tioned inter alia that her mother, Mrs.L.F. BOGOMOLOFF, and
her sister, Miss Irina Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF, resided at Han-
kow at that time. When renewing her registration with the
Committee on 22-2-39 she gave her own and her mother's ad-
dress as Room 2, House 15, Passage 129 Avenue Haig and sta-
ted that her sister, Irina Pavlovna KOSHKIN, resided in
Hardoon Road. From subsequent enquiries it was ascertain-
ed that Irina Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF alias KOSHKIN, who at
present resides at 237 Nanyang Road, Flat 2, is Mrs. L. BEN-
NETT ( vide attached photograph ).

Miss Irina Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF and her mother
are reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Hankow on
24-1-38 in the s.s. "Felix Roussel" travelling third
class via Hongkong. On 10-2-38 they applied to the French Police for
registration. On this occasion Miss I.P. BOGOMOLOFF sta-
ted that she was born on 29-4-1907 at Harbin and that she
was a dressmaker by occupation. She also mentioned that
she had one daughter named Tamara, 13 years of age. The

事由 关于 L. Bennett 夫人的查询。

由特别调查员 Prokofiev 经办。由 C. Clausen 转呈

经 discreet（谨慎/秘密）查询显示，海格路（Avenue Haig）129弄15号并无名为 L. BENNETT 夫人的人士居住。该房屋2号房间由 L.F. BOGOMOLOFF 夫人（56岁，俄国人）及其女儿 Ekaterina Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF 小姐（24岁，职业为芭蕾舞演员，艺名 MELTSER）占用。据报，MELTSER 小姐已订婚，未婚夫为某俄国人。

1937年12月，BOGOMOLOFF-MELTSER 小姐在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）俄国难民委员会登记时，当时她居住在万隆路（Route Vallon）132号，其间提及她的母亲 L.F. BOGOMOLOFF 夫人及妹妹 Irina Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF 小姐当时居住在汉口。1939年2月22日向该委员会更新登记时，她提供自己及母亲的地址为海格路129弄15号2室，并称其妹妹 Irina Pavlovna KOSHKIN 居住在哈同路（Hardoon Road）。经后续查询查明，现居住于南阳路237号2室的 Irina Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF（又名 KOSHKIN）即为 L. BENNETT 夫人（见附照片）。

据报，Irina Pavlovna BOGOMOLOFF 小姐与其母亲于1938年1月24日乘坐“费利克斯·鲁塞尔”号（s.s. "Felix Roussel"）轮船，经香港，乘三等舱从汉口抵达上海。1938年2月10日，她们向法租界巡捕房申请登记。此次，I.P. BOGOMOLOFF 小姐称其于1907年4月29日出生于哈尔滨，职业为裁缝。她还提到她有一个名叫 Tamara 的女儿，年方13岁。该

From the date of her arrival in Shanghai until

At present Mrs BENNETT occupies a two roomed

by the latter as I.P. KOSHKIN ( maiden name of Mrs. L.P.
BOGOLOLOFF ), would seem to indicate that there must be
some reasons why Mrs BENNETT prefers not to be known un-
der her proper name.

March 9, 1939.

D.C. (Divisions).

Sir,

The Rev. F.W. Weaver, Port Chaplain, Mission
to Seamen, 17 Canton Road, requests that discreet en-
quiries regarding a Mrs. L. Bennett, residing at No. 129
Avenue Haig, House 15, Room No. 2.

The lady in question is of Russian origin and
formerly resided in Hankow, where she met her husband
Able Seaman Bennett, who married her at the British
Consulate and brought her to Shanghai.

Bennett has now been returned to England and
apparently tried to abandon his wife, but was forced to
allow her maintenance.

The Naval Authorities will send her to England
if she desires to go, but Bennett has written stating that
he has proof that she is leading an immoral life. The
Port Chaplain has been unable to substantiate this and
requests the assistance of the Police on behalf of the
R.N.O.

〔此处为手写签名〕
P.A. to D.C. (Divisions).

1939年3月9日。

致：各部门副总监。

先生，

广东路17号海员传教会港口牧师 F.W. Weaver 牧师请求对居住在海格路129号15室2号的 L. Bennett 夫人进行谨慎查询。

涉事女士系俄裔，此前居住在汉口，在那里结识了其丈夫一等水兵 Bennett，后者在英国领事馆与她结婚并将她带至上海。

Bennett 现已返回英国，显然试图抛弃妻子，但被迫支付其赡养费。

如果她愿意，海军当局会将她送往英国，但 Bennett 写信称他有证据证明她生活不检点。港口牧师无法证实这一点，故代表皇家海军军官（R.N.O.）请求警方协助。

〔此处为手写签名〕
助理致各部门副总监。
